snippet.title: Hibernation - Indie Horror Game - No Commentary
snippet.description:
Thanks For Watching!

Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Stella-Abbasi-100150965166877/
Twitter https://twitter.com/StellaAbbasi

Download https://insertrave.itch.io/hibernation

A small but eerie town, an unknown killer, and a cash reward! In this short PSX style horror game, you play as a local detective investigating a murder in the hopes of earning themselves some cash for finding the killer. Venture into town, and see what you can find out for yourself!


Indie Horror Game Playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLk0tZ0YT3FZEsIgd3Qdj19xGe9VcMMI1P

#hibernation #Indiegames
